Static Architecture Analysis -- independent TypeScript analysis subsystem
|-- Entry and contract [scripts/analysis/analyze.ts; application/core/static-analysis/ports.ts]
|   |-- CLI reads tsconfig.json -> selects .ts/.tsx files, excluding .d.ts
|   |   |-- Optional path prefixes narrow the selected scope
|   |   `-- Requests all five views and React/Zustand/tldraw/controller summaries
|   |-- StaticAnalyzer.analyze(request) -> artifact + measurements + execution mode
|   |   |-- Inputs: repository root/ID, tsconfig, selected paths, views, frameworks
|   |   `-- Metrics: directory/layer/single-group partitions + shuffle seed/samples
|   `-- Selection limits fact emission; imports may still be read for resolution
|-- Full extraction [infrastructure/core/static-analysis/analyzer.ts]
|   |-- 1. Create AnalysisContext + Declarations
|   |   `-- Index declarations -> imports -> composition
|   |-- 2. Any requested view beyond containment?
|   |   |-- Yes -> extract lexical references
|   |   `-- No  -> skip lexical extraction
|   |-- 3. Calls, ownership, or dependencies requested?
|   |   `-- Initialize resources -> extract calls -> extract framework relationships
|   |       `-- Ownership or dependencies requested?
|   |           `-- Prepare dataflow symbols -> release compiler
|   |               `-- Extract dataflow -> connect callback candidates
|   |-- 4. Finish snapshot -> release context and extraction maps
|   `-- 5. deriveAnalysis(artifact) -> return result
|       `-- Elapsed time, peak RSS and phase timings remain outside persisted facts
|-- Evidence and compiler lifetime [infrastructure/core/static-analysis/context.ts]
|   |-- Start with syntax-only program; build semantic program lazily on checker access
|   |   `-- Pin compiler inputs before release; record whether semantic resolution ran
|   |-- Hash inputs as analyzed, resolution-only, or configuration files
|   |   `-- Snapshot also pins scope, compiler/analyzer versions, config, commit and dirty files
|   |-- Entities and relations carry stable identity keys and source provenance
|   |   |-- Named or structural anchors; collisions become ambiguous identities + issues
|   |   `-- Locations: snapshot ID + file hash + UTF-16 range, exclusive end
|   |-- Relation emission respects requested views; containment is always emitted
|   |-- finish() assigns snapshot ID and recomputes coverage from persisted facts
|   |   `-- Per view: complete / partial / not-run; candidate = resolved + unresolved sites
|   `-- classify() uses shared sourceClassification
|       `-- Related composition subsystem shares classification with architecture boundary tests
|-- Incremental alternative [infrastructure/core/static-analysis/incremental.ts]
|   |-- IncrementalAnalyzer owns reusable component fragments for one session
|   |   |-- Default extractor: the full staticAnalyzer above
|   |   `-- Reject concurrent updates; clone exported/restored checkpoints and validate restores
|   |-- Inventory current files, hashes, import resolutions and environment before reuse
|   |   `-- Includes newly resolvable imports, declaration inputs and package/config changes
|   |-- Choose invalidation groups
|   |   |-- Ordinary case -> dependency components from current imports + cached fact edges
|   |   `-- Uncertain global effects -> combine all local files into one group
|   |       |-- Global scripts or module/global augmentations
|   |       |-- Dynamic import/require with a nonliteral target
|   |       |-- Selected declaration files or declarations depending on ordinary local source
|   |       `-- Node16/NodeNext mode-sensitive module resolution
|   |-- For each group containing selected paths
|   |   |-- Key = environment + selected paths + member hashes + resolution observations
|   |   |-- Cache hit  -> reuse fragment
|   |   `-- Cache miss -> extract selected paths in that group
|   |-- Assemble a fresh snapshot header, even when every fragment is reused
|   |   `-- Preserve configuration pins -> merge facts -> finish -> recompute all derivations
|   `-- Publish next checkpoint only after successful complete assembly
|       `-- Return changed/analyzed/reused/removed files, component count and fallback reasons
|-- Artifact and derivation [domain/core/static-analysis/schema.ts; derive.ts]
|   |-- AnalysisArtifact v1 = snapshot + entities + relations + uncertainties + coverage
|   |   |-- containment  -> contains, imports, reexports, JSX children
|   |   |-- lexical      -> scopes, declarations, references, captures
|   |   |-- calls        -> calls, construction, callback registration/scheduling
|   |   |-- ownership    -> creation, retention, aliases, mutation, subscriptions, disposal
|   |   `-- dependencies -> value/argument/return flow, reads/writes, reactive relationships
|   |-- Derivation universe: eligible source-origin entities in analyzed files
|   |   `-- Excludes structural containers, scopes, interfaces/types and external/unknown targets
|   |-- Partitions -> directory, source layer, or one group
|   |-- Active dependency layers -> calls, data, state, reactive
|   |   |-- Metrics -> line coverage/overlap, edge mass, cohesion, partition comparison
|   |   |   `-- Seeded shuffle baseline preserves primary group sizes and covered set
|   |   `-- Strongly connected components -> condensation graph with relation provenance
|   |-- Findings -> cross-view boundaries, cross-boundary writes, mutable captures, shared state
|   |   `-- Assessment is "investigate"; findings retain supporting entities/relations
|   `-- contains edges -> canonical containment tree
|       `-- Schema also supports source joins and reserved runtime identities
|-- Validation and persistence [domain/core/static-analysis/persistence.ts]
|   |-- Validate records and cross-record invariants before serialization
|   |   |-- Unique identities, valid endpoints, pinned ranges and supporting references
|   |   |-- One repository root; contains forms an acyclic tree with no orphan entities
|   |   |-- Valid SCC condensation, partitions, metric arithmetic and coverage counts
|   |   `-- Optional source texts verify exact UTF-16 coordinates
|   |-- Stream canonical JSON record by record
|   |   |-- Deterministic key/set ordering; propertyPath retains its ordered sequence
|   |   `-- Separate stream verifier checks schemas, canonical bytes and record ordering
|   `-- CLI writes temporary files, then renames each output
|       |-- docs/analysis/artifacts/{selected-scope|whole-repository}.json.gz
|       |-- docs/analysis/architecture-{selected-scope|whole-repository}.md
|       `-- Artifact-side .run.json manifest: hashes, sizes, counts, timing, RSS and timestamp
`-- Integration boundary
    `-- Supplied evidence establishes a CLI-driven subsystem, not a browser generation stage
